name: SpotifyPlaylist

help: This component generates a stream of tracks from a Spotify playlist. Specify the playlist by its URI or URL. If no URI is given but a name is provided, Spotify will be searched for a matching playlist.

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

uri.description: The URI or URL of the playlist
uri.title: Uri

name.description: Display name of the playlist (shown on node)

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (max 10000)
limit.title: Limit

name: MyTopTracks
description: Your most-listened tracks from your listening history
help: This component generates a stream of your most listened to tracks. Top tracks are available over three time spans: short term (last month or so), medium term (last half year or so), and long term (last several years). Note: Spotify limits this to a maximum of 50 tracks.

These are artist entities — connect them to an Expand component to get tracks from these artists.

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives

time_range.description: The time period for top artists

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives

num_tracks.description: Number of tracks per album (blank = all)
num_tracks.title: Num Tracks

num_albums.description: Number of albums to include (blank = all)

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives

help: This component loads tracks from a Spotify playlist and filters them by when they were added, using relative dates (e.g. '7 days', '2 weeks', '3 months'). The 'since' and 'before' fields accept values like: '7 days', '2 weeks', '1 month', '1 year'.

tracks_added_before.description: Only tracks added before this period (e.g. '30 days')

name: RecentlyPlayed

help: This component returns tracks from your recent listening history on Spotify. Spotify typically provides the last ~50 tracks. Use 'after' to get only plays after a relative time (e.g. '60m', '2h', '2 hours', '7d', '7 days'). Use 'before' to get only plays before a relative time. Note: this component requires the 'Recently Played' permission — you may need to log out and log back in to grant it.

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

after.description: Only plays after this time ago (e.g. '60m', '2 hours', '7 days')
after.title: After

before.description: Only plays before this time ago (e.g. '60m', '2 hours', '7 days')
before.title: Before

name: LastFmRecentTracks
description: Loads a Last.fm user's recent scrobbles, resolved to Spotify tracks
help: Fetches recent scrobbles from a Last.fm user's profile and resolves them to Spotify tracks. Tracks that can't be matched on Spotify are skipped. Leave username blank to use your Last.fm username from Settings. Use 'from_date' to limit how far back to look (e.g. '7 days', '30d', '2024-01-01').

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

limit.description: Maximum number of scrobbles to fetch
limit.title: Limit

from_date.description: Only fetch scrobbles after this date (e.g. '7 days', '30d', '2024-01-01')
from_date.title: From Date

name: LastFmTopTracks
description: Loads a Last.fm user's most-played tracks, resolved to Spotify tracks
help: Fetches the top tracks for a Last.fm user over a given time period and resolves them to Spotify tracks. Tracks that can't be matched on Spotify are skipped. Leave username blank to use your Last.fm username from Settings. Results are ordered by play count (most played first).

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to fetch
limit.title: Limit

name: LastFmLovedTracks
description: Loads a Last.fm user's loved tracks, resolved to Spotify tracks
help: Fetches tracks that a Last.fm user has marked as loved and resolves them to Spotify tracks. Tracks that can't be matched on Spotify are skipped. Leave username blank to use your Last.fm username from Settings. Results are in reverse chronological order (most recently loved first).

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

limit.description: Maximum number of loved tracks to fetch
limit.title: Limit

description: Finds tracks similar to a given track using Last.fm listening data
help: Uses Last.fm's listening data to find tracks similar to the specified track, then resolves them to Spotify tracks. Provide an artist and track name. Results are ordered by similarity (most similar first).

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

name: LastFmTagTopTracks
description: Gets the top tracks for a Last.fm tag
help: Fetches the most popular tracks tagged with a given tag on Last.fm (e.g. 'indie', 'shoegaze', 'piano'), then resolves them to Spotify tracks. Results are ordered by tag count (most tagged first).

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

name: LastFmGlobalTopTracks
description: Gets the top tracks from the Last.fm global chart
help: Fetches the current global top tracks chart from Last.fm, then resolves them to Spotify tracks. Results are ordered by popularity (most played first).

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

name: LastFmGeoTopTracks
description: Gets the top tracks for a country from Last.fm
help: Fetches the most popular tracks from the previous week in a given country (and optionally a metro area) from Last.fm, then resolves them to Spotify tracks. Country should be an ISO 3166-1 name (e.g. 'United States', 'Germany', 'Japan').

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

location.description: Optional metro name within the country
location.title: Location

name: CountryTopTracks
description: Top tracks from artists of a given country (via MusicBrainz)
help: Finds artists from a given country using MusicBrainz metadata, ranks them by Spotify popularity, then returns the top tracks from the most popular artists. Enter a country name (e.g. 'Finland', 'Nigeria') or an ISO code (e.g. 'FI', 'NG'). Uses cached artist data when available to minimize API calls, and samples uncached artists to fill gaps (warming the cache for future runs).

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return
limit.title: Limit

artist_sample.description: How many uncached artists to sample when cache coverage is low
artist_sample.title: Artist Sample

name: CountryTopArtists
description: Top charting artists in a given country
help: Gets the unique artists from a country's Spotify chart playlist — the artists currently most streamed in that country. Enter a country name (e.g. 'USA', 'UK', 'Japan') or an ISO code. Artists are ordered by chart position (most streamed first).

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

name: GenreArtists
description: Artists tagged with a given genre (via MusicBrainz)
help:
Finds artists tagged with a specific genre in MusicBrainz, ranked by Spotify popularity. Enter a genre tag like 'shoegaze', 'post-punk', 'ambient', or 'j-pop'. Genre matching is case-insensitive.

By default, only artists whose PRIMARY genre matches are included — this avoids pop stars who happen to have a minor genre tag. Uncheck 'primary only' to include all artists tagged with the genre.

alias.description: Custom source label for track display and distribution objectives
alias.title: Alias

primary_only.description: Only include artists whose primary genre matches
primary_only.title: Primary Only

name: ToTracks
description: Convert artists or albums into their tracks
help: This component takes artist or album entities and produces tracks. The available selection modes depend on the input type. For artists: most popular, least popular, newest, oldest, or random. For albums: album order, random, first N, or last N. Use 'count' to control how many tracks per input item, and 'limit' to cap the total output.

select.description: How to select tracks from each input item
select.title: Select

name: ToArtists
description: Extract unique artists from tracks or albums
help: This component extracts unique artists from a stream of tracks or albums. For tracks: artists are extracted by artist ID and optionally ordered by frequency. For albums: the primary artist of each album is extracted. Enable 'include featured' to also include featured/secondary artists.

order.description: How to order the extracted artists
order.title: Order

include_featured.description: Include featured/secondary artists, not just the primary
include_featured.title: Include Featured

name: ToAlbums
description: Extract albums from tracks, or fetch an artist's albums
help: This component produces album entities. From tracks: extracts unique albums by album ID. From artists: fetches each artist's albums from Spotify. Use 'count' to limit albums per artist. Use 'album types' to filter by type (album, single, compilation, appears_on).

album_types.description: Album types to include (comma-separated: album, single, compilation, appears_on)
album_types.title: Album Types

name: SimilarArtists
description: Find similar artists for each input artist
help: This component takes a stream of artists and produces similar artists for each one, using Spotify's artist radio playlists to discover related artists. Use 'count' to control how many similar artists per input, and 'limit' to cap the total output. The input artist is excluded from the results.

name: Expand
description: Convert artists or albums into their tracks
help: This component takes artist or album entities and produces tracks. The available selection modes depend on the input type. For artists: most popular, least popular, newest, oldest, or random. For albums: album order, random, first N, or last N. Use 'count' to control how many tracks per input item, and 'limit' to cap the total output.

select.description: How to select tracks from each input item
select.title: Select

name: Collapse
description: Extract unique artists from tracks or albums
help: This component extracts unique artists from a stream of tracks or albums. For tracks: artists are extracted by artist ID and optionally ordered by frequency. For albums: the primary artist of each album is extracted. Enable 'include featured' to also include featured/secondary artists.

order.description: How to order the extracted artists
order.title: Order

include_featured.description: Include featured/secondary artists, not just the primary
include_featured.title: Include Featured

name: Shuffler
description: Randomly shuffle items from input streams
help: This component randomly re-orders the input tracks.

name: Concatenate
description: Concatenate items from multiple streams
help: This component takes any number of input streams and produces tracks by retrieving all the tracks from the first stream, followed by all the tracks from the second stream, and so on.

name: RandomSelector
description: Randomly select items from multiple streams
help: This component takes any number of input streams and produces tracks by continuously selecting a random input stream and returning the next track from that stream. If 'fail fast' is set, it stops as soon as any selected source is exhausted.

fail_fast.description: If true, stop as soon as any input stream is exhausted
fail_fast.title: Fail Fast

name: RandomStreamSelector
description: Randomly pick one stream and use it
help: This component picks one input stream at random and uses that entire stream to produce tracks.

name: MixIn
description: Mix two input streams with a configurable ratio
help: This component alternately selects tracks from the green and red streams. Tracks on the green port are the primary stream, and tracks on the red port are mixed in. It plays 'initial skip' green tracks first, then cycles through 'green tracks' from the green stream followed by 'red tracks' from the red stream. If 'fail fast' is set, the component stops when either stream runs out. If not set, it continues with whichever stream still has tracks.

nskips.description: Number of green tracks in a row
nskips.title: Nskips

ntracks.description: Number of red tracks in a row
ntracks.title: Ntracks

initial_skip.description: Number of initial green tracks before first mix-in
initial_skip.title: Initial Skip

fail_fast.description: If true, stop when either stream is exhausted
fail_fast.title: Fail Fast

name: Mixer
description: Advanced multi-stream mixer with dedup and artist separation
help: This component mixes tracks from multiple input streams while maintaining ordering rules. Input streams are on the green port, banned tracks are on the red port, and banned artists are on the orange port. If 'fail fast' is set, the order of input tracks is guaranteed to be preserved and the mixer stops when it can no longer satisfy the constraints. If 'fail fast' is not set, the mixer finds the next best track from the next input stream that best fits the constraints, and continues producing tracks as long as any stream has tracks remaining.

fail_fast.description: Stop when any stream is exhausted
fail_fast.title: Fail Fast

min_artist_separation.description: Minimum gap between same-artist tracks (0 = no limit)
min_artist_separation.title: Min Artist Separation

name: Intersection
description: Output only tracks that appear in all input streams
help: This component takes multiple input streams and outputs only the tracks that appear in every stream. The output order follows the first input stream.

name: Annotator
description: Legacy passthrough — annotation is now automatic
help: This component is vestigial. Audio feature annotation now happens automatically in the pipeline. Existing programs that use this component will continue to work — it simply passes tracks through.

name: IsWeekend
description: Route items based on whether today is a weekend
help: This component accepts a green and a red stream. If the current day is a weekend, tracks from the green stream are passed through; otherwise tracks from the red stream are passed through.

name: YesNo
description: Select a stream based on a boolean
help: This component accepts a green and a red input stream. If 'yes' is set, tracks from the green stream are passed through; otherwise tracks from the red stream are passed through.

yes.description: If true, use the green stream; otherwise use the red stream
yes.title: Yes

name: IsDayOfWeek
description: Route items based on the current day of the week
help: This component accepts a green and a red stream. If today matches the specified day, tracks from the green stream are passed through; otherwise tracks from the red stream are passed through.

name: DateRange
description: Route items based on whether today falls within a date range
help: This component accepts a green and a red stream. If today's date falls within the specified range, tracks from the green stream are passed through; otherwise tracks from the red stream are passed through. Handles ranges that wrap around year boundaries (e.g. Dec 1 – Jan 31).

name: DeprecatedSource
description: Placeholder for components that are no longer available
help: This component replaces a source type that is no longer available. It cannot produce any tracks. Replace it with an available source.

original_type.description: The original component type that was replaced
original_type.title: Original Type

name: DeDup
description: Remove duplicate items from a stream
help:
This component removes duplicate items from the stream. Works on tracks, artists, and albums.

If 'By Name' is set, items are matched by name: tracks and albums by title + artist, artists by name alone. This catches different versions of the same item. Otherwise items are matched by their Spotify ID.

by_name.description: If true, match by name and artist; otherwise match by track ID only
by_name.title: By Name

name: AttributeRangeFilter
description: Filter items by an attribute range
help: This component filters the input stream and only passes through tracks whose attribute value falls within the specified range.

release_year.description: Year the track was released (derived from release_date)

total_tracks.description: Number of tracks on the album

random.description: Random value (0.0–1.0), regenerated each run — use in MOS to add variety

artist_end_year.description: Year artist ended activity (empty if still active)

source_count.description: Number of times this entity appeared in the source stream

name: TrackFilter
description: Remove tracks from a stream
help: This component takes two input streams. It produces tracks from the green input stream with the tracks on the red input stream removed. If 'invert' is set, only tracks that appear on both streams are passed through. If 'By Name' is set, tracks are matched by artist and title in addition to track ID.

invert.description: If true, only tracks on both streams are passed through
invert.title: Invert

by_name.description: If true, also match by artist and title in addition to track ID
by_name.title: By Name

name: TextFilter
description: Filter tracks with titles matching a given string
help: This component passes through tracks whose title matches the given text string. The text is treated as a regular expression. Set 'invert' to pass through only non-matching tracks. Set 'ignore case' to make the match case-insensitive.

text.description: Regular expression to match against track title
text.title: Text

ignore_case.description: If true, matching ignores letter case
ignore_case.title: Ignore Case

invert.description: If true, pass through non-matching tracks
invert.title: Invert

name: MatchFilter
description: Filter items by matching a string attribute against a pattern
help: This component filters tracks based on whether a string attribute (title, artist, or album) matches a given value. You can choose exact match, substring match, or regex match. Use 'invert' to pass through only non-matching tracks. Useful for filtering out remixes, live versions, etc.

match_type.description: How to match: exact, substring, or regex
match_type.title: Match Type

ignore_case.description: If true, matching ignores letter case
ignore_case.title: Ignore Case

invert.description: If true, pass through non-matching items
invert.title: Invert

source.description: Source component that produced the track

artist_gender.description: Artist/vocalist gender (male, female, mixed, instrumental, other, unknown)

artist_type.description: Artist type (person, group, orchestra, choir, character, other)

artist_country.description: Artist country (ISO 3166-1 code, e.g. US, GB)

artist_area.description: Artist area name (city, region, or country)

relinked_id.description: Spotify ID of the market-appropriate replacement track (if relinked)

name: Explicit
description: Filter tracks by their explicit attribute
help: This component filters tracks based on whether they are marked as explicit. If 'explicit' is true, only explicit tracks pass through. If false, only clean tracks pass through.

explicit.description: If true, only explicit tracks pass; if false, only clean tracks pass
explicit.title: Explicit

name: ArtistDeDup
description: Ensure only unique artists appear in the stream
help: This component removes items with duplicate artists from the stream. Works on tracks, artists, and albums — the first item for each artist is kept, subsequent duplicates are removed.

name: MaxTracksPerArtist
description: Limit the number of tracks by any single artist
help: This component limits how many tracks by the same artist can pass through. Once an artist has reached the maximum, any further tracks by that artist are removed.

max_tracks.description: Maximum number of tracks allowed per artist
max_tracks.title: Max Tracks

name: ArtistSeparation
description: Enforce a minimum gap between tracks by the same artist
help: This component guarantees that tracks by the same artist will not appear closer together than the given minimum separation. If 'reorder' is set, tracks may be reordered to enforce the separation; otherwise offending tracks are removed.

min_separation.description: Minimum number of tracks between tracks by the same artist
min_separation.title: Min Separation

reorder.description: If true, reorder tracks to enforce separation instead of removing them
reorder.title: Reorder

name: SimpleArtistFilter
description: Remove tracks by the given artists
help: This component removes tracks from the input stream that are by the given set of artists. Artists are specified as a comma-separated list.

artistNames.description: Comma-separated list of artist names to remove
artistNames.title: Artistnames

name: ArtistFilter
description: Filter any stream by artist
help:
This component takes two input streams. It removes items from the green stream whose artist appears on the red stream. If 'invert' is set, only items by artists on the red stream are passed through.

Both inputs accept any entity type — tracks, artists, or albums. Artist names are extracted automatically: from the artist name for artist entities, and from the track/album artist field for tracks and albums.

invert.description: If true, only items by artists on the red stream are passed through
invert.title: Invert

name: ReleaseDateFilter
description: Filter items by release date range
help: This component filters the input stream and only passes through items whose release date falls within the specified range. Works on tracks and albums. Dates can be absolute (e.g. '2020', '2020-06', '2020-06-15') or relative (e.g. '6 months', '1 year', '30 days').

name: Danceable
description: Filter tracks by danceability
help: This component filters tracks by their danceability score. Scale: most (0.75-1.0), more (0.5-1.0), less (0-0.5), least (0-0.25), all (no filter).

scale.description: How danceable: most, more, less, least, or all
scale.title: Scale

name: Energy
description: Filter tracks by energy level
help: This component filters tracks by their energy score. Scale: most (0.75-1.0), more (0.5-1.0), less (0-0.5), least (0-0.25), all (no filter).

scale.description: How energetic: most, more, less, least, or all
scale.title: Scale

name: Live
description: Filter tracks by liveness
help: This component filters tracks by their liveness score. Higher values indicate the track was likely performed live.

scale.description: How live: most, more, less, least, or all
scale.title: Scale

name: Spoken Word
description: Filter tracks by speechiness
help: This component filters tracks by their speechiness score. Higher values indicate more spoken word content (talk shows, podcasts, rap).

scale.description: How speech-like: most, more, less, least, or all
scale.title: Scale

name: GenreFilter
description: Filter tracks by MusicBrainz genre
help:
This component filters tracks by genre using MusicBrainz genre data. Enter a genre like 'rock', 'electronic', or 'hip hop'. By default, substring matching is used so 'rock' matches 'alternative rock', 'art rock', etc. Use exact matching for precise genre names. Set 'invert' to exclude matching tracks instead.

Enable 'primary genre only' to match only the artist's first (most relevant) genre instead of the full list. This avoids false positives from deep genre tags — e.g. filtering by 'jazz' won't match a pop artist who happens to have 'jazz' as a minor genre.

match_type.description: How to match: substring or exact
match_type.title: Match Type

primary_genre_only.description: Only match the artist's primary (first) genre, ignoring minor genre tags
primary_genre_only.title: Primary Genre Only

invert.description: If true, exclude matching tracks instead
invert.title: Invert

name: GenderFilter
description: Filter tracks by artist/vocalist gender
help: Filter tracks by the gender of the artist or vocalist. For solo artists, this is their gender directly. For bands, this reflects the vocalist(s): male, female, or mixed. Groups with no vocalist data show as 'unknown'. Orchestras are classified as 'instrumental'.

invert.description: If true, exclude matching tracks instead
invert.title: Invert

name: CountryFilter
description: Filter tracks by artist country
help: Filter tracks by the artist's country of origin using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. US, GB, JP, SE, DE). Country data comes from MusicBrainz.

country.description: ISO country code (e.g. US, GB, JP)
country.title: Country

invert.description: If true, exclude matching tracks instead
invert.title: Invert

name: Tempo
description: Filter tracks by BPM range
help: This component filters tracks by their tempo (beats per minute).

name: SimilarTracks
description: For each input track, find tracks by similar artists
help: For each input track, finds tracks by similar artists. Use it to expand a small seed playlist into a larger collection of related music. By default, tracks by the same artist as the input track are excluded. Tracks are deduplicated across all inputs, and input tracks themselves are never included in the output.

count.description: Number of similar tracks to find per input track
count.title: Count

exclude_same_artist.description: Exclude tracks by the same artist as the input track
exclude_same_artist.title: Exclude Same Artist

name: PlayableFilter
description: Remove tracks that are not playable in your market
help: Removes tracks that Spotify reports as unplayable in your country/market. Some tracks are region-locked and won't play even if they appear in playlists. Enable 'relink' to replace unplayable tracks with market-appropriate alternatives when Spotify provides them, instead of dropping them.

relink.description: Replace unplayable tracks with playable alternatives when available
relink.title: Relink

name: Sorter
description: Sort items by a given attribute
help: This component orders tracks based on the given attribute. The sort can be reversed by selecting the 'reverse' option.

reverse.description: If true, reverse the sort order
reverse.title: Reverse

source.description: Source component that produced the track

release_year.description: Year the track was released (derived from release_date)

total_tracks.description: Number of tracks on the album

random.description: Random value (0.0–1.0), regenerated each run — use in MOS to add variety

artist_gender.description: Artist/vocalist gender (male, female, mixed, instrumental, other, unknown)

artist_type.description: Artist type (person, group, orchestra, choir, character, other)

artist_country.description: Artist country (ISO 3166-1 code, e.g. US, GB)

artist_area.description: Artist area name (city, region, or country)

artist_end_year.description: Year artist ended activity (empty if still active)

source_count.description: Number of times this entity appeared in the source stream

relinked_id.description: Spotify ID of the market-appropriate replacement track (if relinked)

name: Reverse
description: Reverse the order of items in a stream
help: This component reverses the order of the input tracks.

name: Weighted Shuffler
description: Shuffle items with controllable randomness
help: This component randomly re-orders the input items. The amount of re-ordering is controlled by the randomness factor (0 to 1). Closer to 1 means more random; closer to 0 retains more of the original order. A factor of 0.1 will lightly shuffle.

name: SeparateArtists
description: Reorder to maximize distance between same-artist tracks
help: Reorders tracks so that each artist's songs are spread as far apart as possible. Every artist's tracks are scheduled at evenly-spaced ideal positions across the whole playlist, and back-to-back tracks by the same artist are avoided whenever possible. The relative order of tracks within each artist is preserved.

name: SmartMix
description: Reorder tracks for smooth DJ-style transitions
help: Reorders tracks to minimize jarring transitions using a greedy nearest-neighbor algorithm. Considers genre similarity, energy flow, harmonic compatibility (Camelot wheel), and tempo smoothness. Adjust the weights to prioritize what matters most for your mix. Feed in more tracks than the limit to give the algorithm a larger pool to find good matches.

name: MultiObjectiveSequencer
description: Sequence tracks using multiple weighted objectives
help: Sequences tracks from the input pool by greedily selecting the best-scoring track at each step. Add multiple objectives (maximize, minimize, range, min-separation) to control which tracks are preferred and in what order. Each objective has a weight that controls its importance. The 'unbreakable' weight means the sequencer stops if no candidate satisfies that objective.

name: PlaylistSave
description: Save tracks to a Spotify playlist
help:
Saves tracks to a Spotify playlist. Give it a name and it will create the playlist on the first run, then update the same playlist on every run after that — no duplicates.

You can also point it at an existing playlist by pasting in a Spotify URI or URL (leave the URI blank to create a new one automatically). Turn on 'append' to add tracks to the playlist instead of replacing them — great for building up an archive over time (e.g. saving each week's Discover Weekly into one big playlist).

If you change the playlist name, a new playlist will be created with the new name on the next run.

When appending, you can set a trim mode to automatically manage playlist size. 'max_tracks' caps the playlist at N total tracks by removing the oldest when exceeded. 'max_age_days' removes any tracks added more than N days ago before appending new ones.

You can also set an auto-reset schedule to periodically clear the playlist and start fresh. Choose 'weekly' (reset on a given day, 0=Monday through 6=Sunday) or 'monthly' (reset on a given day of the month). On reset days, the playlist is replaced instead of appended to; on other days it appends normally.

The description field is written to the Spotify playlist and supports template variables like ${DATE} and ${NUM_TRACKS}. See the FAQ for the full list.

Turn on 'no duplicates' to prevent the same track from being added twice. In append mode, incoming tracks are checked against the tracks already in the playlist and any duplicates are skipped — great for archiving playlists like Daily Mix without accumulating repeats. In replace mode it just removes duplicates from the incoming tracks.

If this is your program's main output (the starred component), it replaces the automatic save, so you won't get duplicate playlists.

playlist_uri.description: URI or URL of an existing Spotify playlist. Leave blank to create a new one automatically.
playlist_uri.title: Playlist Uri

trim_mode.description: Playlist management: cap total tracks or remove old tracks (only when appending)
trim_mode.title: Trim Mode

trim_value.description: Max track count (max_tracks) or max age in days (max_age_days)
trim_value.title: Trim Value

auto_reset.description: Periodically clear the playlist before appending (only when appending)
auto_reset.title: Auto Reset

reset_value.description: Day of week for weekly (0=Mon, 6=Sun), or day of month for monthly (1-31)
reset_value.title: Reset Value

no_dups.description: Skip tracks already in the playlist (append mode) or deduplicate incoming tracks (replace mode)
no_dups.title: No Dups

description.description: Playlist description written to Spotify. Supports variables: ${DATE}, ${TIME}, ${PROGRAM_NAME}, ${PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION}, ${AUTO_PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION}, ${NUM_TRACKS}, ${NUM_ARTISTS}, ${USER}, ${DAY-OF-WEEK}, ${UPDATE_SCHEDULE}, ${DURATION}, ${PLAYLIST_NAME}. See the FAQ for details.
description.title: Description

name: PlaylistSaveToNew
description: Save tracks to a new playlist with an auto-generated suffix
help:
Creates a new playlist each time it runs, with a suffix appended to the name based on the selected type: time (HH:MM), date (YYYY-MM-DD), day-of-week (Monday, etc.), day-of-month (1-31), or none.

The description field is written to the Spotify playlist and supports template variables like ${DATE} and ${NUM_TRACKS}. See the FAQ for the full list.

If used as your program's main output (the starred component), it replaces the automatic save — no duplicate playlists.

description.description: Playlist description written to Spotify. Supports variables: ${DATE}, ${TIME}, ${PROGRAM_NAME}, ${PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION}, ${AUTO_PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION}, ${NUM_TRACKS}, ${NUM_ARTISTS}, ${USER}, ${DAY-OF-WEEK}, ${UPDATE_SCHEDULE}, ${DURATION}, ${PLAYLIST_NAME}. See the FAQ for details.
description.title: Description

name: comment
description: A comment node for annotating the graph
help: This component is a no-op comment for annotating the program graph.

name: Alternate
description: Alternate items from multiple input streams
help: This component takes any number of input streams and generates a single output stream by alternating between each of the input streams. It continues until all input sources are exhausted.

ports.description: The input streams to alternate between

fail_fast.description: If true, stop as soon as any input stream is exhausted
fail_fast.title: Fail Fast

name: First
description: Return the first items from a stream
help: This component passes through only the first 'count' items from the input stream. Use it to limit a stream to a fixed number of items.

sample_size.description: The number of items to return
sample_size.title: Sample Size

name: Last
description: Return the last items from a stream
help: This component returns the last 'count' items from the input stream.

sample_size.description: The number of items to return
sample_size.title: Sample Size

name: Sample
description: Randomly sample items from a stream
help: This component randomly samples up to 'count' items from the input stream. Sampled items may be returned in any order.

sample_size.description: The number of items to return
sample_size.title: Sample Size

name: AllButTheFirst
description: Return all but the first items from a stream
help: This component skips the first 'count' items and passes through the rest.

sample_size.description: The number of items to skip
sample_size.title: Sample Size

name: AllButTheLast
description: Return all but the last items from a stream
help: This component passes through all items except the last 'count'.

sample_size.description: The number of items to drop from the end
sample_size.title: Sample Size

name: ShorterThan
description: Limit stream to tracks fitting within a time duration
help: This component passes through the first N tracks whose total duration is no longer than the given time.

name: LongerThan
description: Accumulate tracks until total duration meets a minimum
help: This component passes through the first N tracks needed to reach at least the given total duration.

name: Pager
description: Page through a source across multiple runs
help: Each time this component runs, it returns the next batch of items from the input source. On the first run it returns items 1 through N, on the second run items N+1 through 2N, and so on. When it reaches the end it wraps around to the beginning. This is useful with scheduled programs to progressively work through a large playlist.
